title: On the Fueter-Sce theorem and Cauchy-Kovalevskaya extensions over alternative $\ast$-algebras
summary: Recently, the concept of generalized partial-slice monogenic (or regular) functions has been introduced and studied over Clifford algebras and octonions, respectively. In this paper, we further develop the theory of generalized partial-slice monogenic functions defined on hypercomplex subspaces and with values in a real alternative $\ast$-algebra and we concentrate on the Fueter-Sce theorem, three types of Cauchy-Kovalevskaya extensions, and their various internal relationships. The paper proposes more bridges between the theories of monogenicity, harmonicity, and generalized partial-slice…
